spec_match.rationale: Bitrate-ladder controller driven by estimatedSendRate (null handled), smoothedRtt-minRtt queueing and lostOutgoing deltas — the adaptation use case from ChromeStatus' motivation.

interactive.rationale: Three labelled sources (live / recorded real trace / what-if), step/play/pause/rewind, headroom and queueing sliders, decision log; verified tier changes (4K at 12 snapshots, 1440p after setting queueing to 1 ms, audio-only on typed loss).

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page does, including its labelled fallback.

edge_cases.rationale: null estimatedSendRate holds the tier, absent RTT members are not treated as zero, and the decision rule uses hysteresis.

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/5120203192139776 plus the relevant spec section.

conformance.rationale: Logic is application-level; only the getStats shape is covered by conformance.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp not available in this environment): every control exercised at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, default and with --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats; success path driven against a test-only local Deno 2.9.8 WebTransport echo (serverCertificateHashes). 0 page errors, 0 failed HTTP requests, 0px overflow, screenshots read. Console shows Chrome's own 'Failed to establish a connection' messages for the deliberately failing https://getstats-probe.invalid/ transports (conformance panel + failure experiments) — expected, not runtime errors. Public Edge echo servers unreachable from this sandbox (egress proxy: ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED), so a real-network session was not verified.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert records the support probe (with fallback flag) and the primary getStats() contract separately.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; buttons set background and color together; status colours emerald-dark/rose/blue on ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Radio fieldset with legend, labelled sliders with output elements, aria-current on the chosen tier, role=log polite decision log, and a source banner on every log line.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow, no control under 44px tall, tables stack into labelled cards on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Verify against a real network echo server
openQuestions.detail: Only loopback (local Deno echo) sessions could be established here; the public wt-ord/wt-ams.akaleapi.net:6161 servers were unreachable through the sandbox's egress proxy. Re-run on a normal network (and on a Chrome 159 build without the flag) to see non-trivial RTTs, lostOutgoing and expiredOutgoing.

openQuestions.title: Record a real lossy-network trace
openQuestions.detail: The recorded sample is loopback (Gbit/s estimates, no loss), so every tier fits. Capture a trace over a real WAN path (or netem-shaped link) so the replay demonstrates step-downs without the what-if source.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for async status updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per result area; announce outcomes, not interstitial 'loading' noise; role=img + title/desc on non-decorative SVG; text table alternative for charts; :focus-visible; >=24px targets, larger on coarse pointers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Outcome panels aria-live=polite/role=status; support verdict role=status; SVG charts role=img with title/desc updated per sample plus a semantic history table; native buttons/inputs with 3px focus-visible outline; all controls >=44px.

guidanceConsulted.query: form url input validation labels and error messages
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible labels, hints via aria-describedby, :user-invalid styling only after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: URL/hash/number inputs have <label for> + aria-describedby hints; URL input required with :user-invalid border; connection failures are announced through the role=status connection line.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid with minmax(0,1fr) tracks, min-width:0 children, auto-fit KPI grid.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shared wts-demo.css: minmax(0,1fr) control grid, auto-fit minmax(min(100%,10rem),1fr) KPI grid, overflow-wrap on code/readouts.

summary: Interactive, real-API demo; the success path was verified on Chrome 153 with the WebTransportStats flag against a local echo server, but not over a real network or on a Chrome 159 build.
